warnings: 8 RC beam segments at floor level (the only RC beam plan in the set; the roof is a steel frame on S-02). No beam level is printed on this sheet; the floor is +0.64 (A-04).

The 4 perimeter beams run column to column (B6 on rows A and B, B3 on grid 1, B4 on grid 2), 5.00 each. The 4 infill beams sit on no column: B5 on 1'' (x 2.00) from row A to row B, the short B1 on 1''''' (x 3.20) from row A to the B2 line, B2 on A''' (y 1.50) from B5 to grid 2, and the long B1 on A'''''' (y 3.60) from grid 1 to B5 (S-01 chains 2.00 | 1.20 | 1.80 and 1.50 | 2.10 | 1.40). Section 5 splits only at supports, so a perimeter beam that only receives an infill beam stays one segment.

B5: the printed 2.00 tick touches its left face; its centre is ~2.10 by scale. Recorded on 1'' (the printed line); the two spans ending on B5 (B2 3.00, long B1 2.00) are face-referenced at that end, so their confidence is lowered to 0.85.

Mark B1 is used for two different infill beams (vertical at x 3.20 and horizontal at y 3.60) — same mark, same section on S-04, so both keep element_id B1 (one member type, two positions; not a collision).

Step marks on the plan are ST-01 / ST-02 while the S-03 details are titled ST-1 / ST-2. Matched by riser: ST-1 has 3 x 0.213 = 0.64 (the รับแขก floor +0.64 down to ±0.00 at the row-A exit marked ลง on A-03) and ST-2 has 3 x 0.18 = 0.54 (ระเบียง +0.54, marked ขึ้น on A-03). Stair refs are approximate nearest points (section 10a).

Slab marks: PS = precast prestressed plank (spans along x — the span arrows are horizontal in all three PS fields), S1 = cast-in-place two-way slab (drawn with an X). The S1 fields are the two +0.54 rooms (ห้องน้ำ top right, ระเบียง bottom left on A-03).
